about_the_game:
This Bundle Contains:

  • 2D style: "Purifying Flame" with unique Marks of Excellence (for French vehicles only)
  • Unique Commander: Patricia Laserian with Mentor and Repair perks, a zero perk of your choice, and enough XP for an extra perk (for French vehicles only)
  • Decal: "Eternal Vigilance" ×6 (for French vehicles only)
  • Decal: "Long Live the Faithful" ×6 (for French vehicles only)

NOTE: This DLC is only available until October 7, 2024.

Bundle Description:

Demonstrate your unwavering loyalty to the Emperor of Mankind! Procure this bundle to adorn your vehicles with the "Purifying Flame" 2D style, "Eternal Vigilance" and "Long Live the Faithful" decals, all inspired by the Adepta Sororitas, His most faithful warriors. Recruit the battle-hardened Patricia Laserian as a Commander!

Patricia Laserian. Adepta Sororitas Palatine. Having a devout heart and a tactician’s mind, she is a distinguished combatant even among the members of Adepta Sororitas who are primed to prevail against any odds by rigorous drills and countless battles. Her maxim is: "Your training will help you aim the blow, but your faith will make it decisive".

Patricia Laserian is only suitable for French vehicles and has a fixed Commander specialization. She has Jack of All Trades and Repair perks, a zero perk of your choice, and enough XP for an extra perk.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.

You will be able to use this DLC only if you play from the game account created on Steam.
